name: License Applications
description:
This dataset contains records of business license applications, with 5,000 sampled rows and 35 columns. Each row represents a single application and includes an application ID, license number, business name and trade name, a business unique ID, business category, application and license types, and the intake channel through which the application was submitted. It also records submission and closure dates, current status, and whether a temporary operating letter was issued along with its expiration date.

Contact and location details are included, such as phone number, address components (building number, street, unit, city, state, ZIP), borough, community board, council district, BIN, BBL, neighborhood tabulation area, census block and tract, and latitude/longitude coordinates. These fields support geographic analysis and mapping of applications across neighborhoods.

The data could be used to track application volumes and processing timelines, compare approval or closure patterns by license type, business category, or intake channel, and examine the geographic distribution of license applications.
